name: bus-factor-check
description: Find knowledge concentration in a git repository: the folders and files where the recent changes come from one or two people. Reads the history with git log --numstat (a fixed list of arguments, no shell) or from a saved log, follows renames, maps aliases and leaves out bots, and reports for each file and folder the authors, the share of the top author, the fewest authors who hold a given share of the changed lines and the last change. Rules and thresholds come from the configuration only; --explain shows the numbers behind each finding. Email addresses are hidden by default. No dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
